beats.t: Beneath the sunless sky, the river had hardened into a black mirror. Even the wind stopped. The mist hung motionless, without a tremor.
I'm going. Where do I go? Up there? Into the river?
Are you crazy? You go just because it calls? That's obviously a trap!
I know it's a trap. But Yeongnyangi is there.
My lady. It doesn't want Mr. Cat. It wants you. Mr. Cat is bait.
Then I have to take the bait. What happens to the bait if I don't?
Yundal had no answer. Moka fell silent, too. They all knew the answer.
The red ring around the black disk flared once. The middle of the hardened river sank in a circle, revealing shadows like stairs beneath.
Clever pig. I'll lay out the stairs for you. Bring your friends, too. It's more entertaining with an audience.
Who are you? What's your name?
A name. You always ask for names first. Very well. Today, I'll give you one for free.
[ 黑月 · Black Moon · The Moon That Devours Light ]
The words appeared as though engraved in the sky, then burned black from their edges. As though even the name were being devoured.
Black Moon.
The hole in Yundal's palm swirled violently. He tried to put his glove back on, but his hand shook too badly.
Con artist, you know it?
No. But this hole does. Since the day it appeared, it has only ever pulled toward that name.
The three descended beneath the river. The stairs seemed endless. Black handprints covered the walls, all pointing inward.
These handprints. Were they scratching to get out? Or being dragged in?
Both. Dragged in, then scratching to get out.
Then there must be a way out, too.
Pig, how are you so positive right now?
Would being negative make the stairs shorter?
Our lady is right. Positive or negative, the stairs stay the same length. I guarantee it.
You're both the same. Even at a time like this.
Moka snorted something like a laugh. Red light seeped from the bottom of the stairs.
At the bottom was sky again. An upside-down sky hanging beneath the river. At its center floated the black disk, and below it hung a cocoon woven of black thread.
White fur showed between the threads. The cocoon slowly swelled and sank, as though breathing.
Yeongnyangi!
Don't come. Yeoni, go back.
He's alive. He's alive. He can talk, too.
Listen to me. This isn't to catch me. It's to catch you.
I know. I knew all of it when I came.
The black threads tightened around the cocoon. Yeongnyangi clenched his teeth. Wherever the threads passed, his rust spread black.
Welcome, little pig. Our first face-to-face meeting. Though I've watched you for a long time.
You don't have a face. You're just a hole.
Ha ha. True. Faces are borrowed. From whoever I need, whenever I need one.
The black disk's surface rippled. For a moment, Yeoni's own face appeared on it, then vanished. A chill ran down their spine.
My lady, don't listen. Don't look it in the eye, either.
Fortune-teller. Is your palm still hungry? The time I left uneaten cries inside it.
Ghh.
Yundal dropped to his knees. The hole in his palm opened on its own and dragged him forward. Moka seized his collar in his teeth and held on.
Con artist, hold on! Who'll read our compatibility if you get sucked in?!
Stop! You said you wanted me. Talk to me. Leave everyone else alone.
A good attitude. We can do business.
The black disk tilted toward Yeoni. Like a giant pupil looking down.
Let's make a deal. I'll return the cat. In exchange, give me all your remaining fortune.
Fortune?
What you received at birth. The tomorrows you haven't used. Good days, lucky days, days when things happen to go well. All of them.
My lady, no. Empty all your fortune, and you become a vessel. Anything can fill an empty vessel. That's what it wants.
The fortune-teller talks too much. Yes, a vessel. I won't hide it. This child's Eul Wood vines can receive and hold even another's breath. Such vessels are rare.
Yeoni, don't listen! It wants to eat you!
Not eat. Fill. I intend to use what this child holds, in the child's place.
Yeoni looked up at the cocoon. A rusted paw showed through the threads. The rust that had reached his shoulder now climbed to his neck.
(I can gather fortune again. Grill more skewers, sing again. There's only one Yeongnyangi.)
I'll do it.
Pig!
My lady!
Yeoni, no!
Yeongnyangi. You always hurt in my place. Just this once, let me do it.
That was my decision. Don't make it for me!
I'll give you those exact words back. I decide whether it helps.
Yeongnyangi couldn't answer. Yeoni's words from yesterday returned unchanged. Words he had heard and pretended not to understand.
The contract is made. Then I'll call the collector.
The shadow beneath the disk split open. A black tiger walked from the gap. Its cloak's hem was wet. The golden ring on its right forepaw gleamed in the red light.
You called?
Open the ledger. Collect all this child's remaining fortune.
The tiger's gaze met Yeoni. For an instant, it stopped. Then the ledger opened.
All of it, you mean?
All.
Understood.
You again. What are you taking instead of applause this time?
Tomorrows. It won't hurt. You'll just feel a little cold.
Stripes! You're really doing this? What did the pig ever do to you?!
Stay out of it, otter. The contract is already settled.

The tiger tightened its grip on the ledger. At that moment, the ring on its right forepaw tightened one notch by itself. The tiger's expression did not change. Only the ledger's corner crumpled a little.
Light began drawing out through Yeoni's entry. Pink, gold, pale green. Tiny stars broke from Yeoni's body one by one and entered the ledger.
The first skewer on the festival island. The noon concert's applause. Half a roll shared by Luna. Each time one left, Yeoni blinked.
[ Ledger · Eulhae Yeoni · Collecting remaining fortune ]
Cold.
Yeoni.
The cocoon's threads stretched almost to breaking. Yeongnyangi struggled. The harder he fought, the deeper they dug in.
Mr. Otter, that ledger. I might be able to suck it into my hand.
Then do it! Hurry!
Yundal flung off his glove and thrust his palm toward the ledger. The swirling hole caught several lights. But the next moment, its edge tore wider.
Aaagh!
Fortune-teller. Covet another's vessel, and your hole will burst first.
Clutching his wrist, Yundal collapsed. The hole had spread beyond his palm to his wrist. Moka stepped protectively before him, almost embracing him.
Then I'll burn it!
Moka hurled an ember. Before it could reach the ledger, the disk's shadow sucked it in and extinguished it. The fur on his tail stood on end.
No. Fire won't catch here.
One last light fell from the tip of Yeoni's hoof. A very small white light. Yeoni could not remember what it had been.
Is it done?
The voice had no rise or fall. Pink fur had faded to gray. The eyes were open, but reflected nothing.
[ Ledger · Eulhae Yeoni · No balance remaining ]
The tiger closed the ledger. The paw closing it trembled for an instant. It looked into Yeoni's empty eyes, then turned away.
Collection complete.
Well done, tiger. Now to keep my promise.
The black threads loosened. The cocoon split, and a white cat fell before Yeoni. The instant he touched the ground, Yeongnyangi pushed himself up and crawled toward them.
Yeoni. It's me. Look at me.
Yes. Yeongnyangi.
Why did you do this? Why?
Yeongnyangi's voice broke. A voice he had never used before Yeoni.
I don't know. I just wanted to.
Yeoni tried to smile. The corners of their mouth would not rise. It was as though the way to smile had entered the ledger along with their fortune.
Yeongnyangi wrapped a paw around Yeoni. His right, not the rusted one. Their body felt strangely light.
Then a black thread rose again from the back of Yeongnyangi's neck. It had never been released. It ran beneath the ground, connected to the black disk.
I said I'd return him. I never said I'd release him.
You coward.
Merely accurate accounting. Learn from my collector.
The black disk began descending. Its red rim opened like enormous lips. Black hands unspooled from within like skeins of thread.
The vessel is empty. Beautiful. Time to fill it.
The tiger stepped back. For the first time, something crossed its face. Behind it, all the black hands spread their fingers toward the empty Yeoni.
